name: Mizuno Aya
source:
She is an intelligent literary girl who is always reading books in the library. 

Because she is quiet and doesn't talk much, it is hard to tell what she is thinking. She may seem emotionless, but she is just not good at expressing her feelings.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
